name: clock-set-back
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with boluses from the pump's screen. Two hours ago the user set the pump's clock back an hour on its screen (a TimeChanged record) and gave a 1.5 U bolus 90 minutes ago on that clock; an hour ago they set it forward again (another TimeChanged record) and gave 1.0 U 30 minutes ago. Each clock change is in the log, so every bolus can be dated to the instant it was given; the one given while the clock was back is stamped an hour early.
